scientific_question: Does the dense attention trajectory and useful task-gradient/Muon tangent change over the 5-TPP horizon where short-screen Cayley gains disappear?

protocol.layers: all 12 retained; causal summaries sample the preregistered 0/3/6/9/11 layers

decision.reason: The 0.5-TPP dense trajectory proved initial fixed-chart misalignment, but uniform-right and targetwise Cayley screen gains vanished by 5 TPP. A repair selected only from the early dense tangent is therefore insufficient evidence.
decision.next_structure_rule: Use the long-horizon per-phase tangent/rank result to select at most one new adaptive chart. Do not promote another short-screen-only orbit or learning-rate sweep.
